projects.name: Pepper — The Personal AI Prompter (Peppr)
projects.role: sole author (attested; README: 'Built by Amogh Maddur')
bullets: Building Pepper, a Chrome and Edge (Manifest V3) extension that turns a few rough words into a six-part prompt built from the user's own profile, memories and project files, and places it in the chat box of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity or Copilot without sending it.

Calls the user's chosen model (Anthropic or OpenAI, with the user's own key) to rewrite each prompt, falls back to an on-device template without a key, and holds back any facts the model assumed until the user confirms them.
Personalises after onboarding: 15 profile answers shape each prompt, and after five ratings Pepper defaults to the user's best-rated approach for that kind of work and shows why.
Covered by 75 unit tests, all passing, including prompt-injection and concurrent-write tests; no backend, with all data kept in chrome.storage.local.
